newsitem.title: INDIA: GEC Alsthom India 96/97 net falls - UNI.
newsitem.headline: GEC Alsthom India 96/97 net falls - UNI.

text.p: Machinery maker GEC Alsthom India Ltd's net profit fell to 27.2 million rupees in 1996/97 from 80 million in 1995/96, the United News of India (UNI) said on Thursday.
The company's sales increased to 5.25 billion rupees in 1996/97 from 4.65 billion in 1995/96, the news agency said.
The company declared a dividend of 10 percent for 1996/97, it said.
The news agency quoted the company as saying that higher financing costs and lower sales of transformers and low voltage equipment led to the fall in net profit.
It said that in 1996/97, GEC Alsthom India transformed its furnace business into a wholly-owned subsidiary, GA Danieli India Ltd.
